supplier.todoIntro: This shows the full example of how todos appear, get triaged, enter business pages, and loop back with status updates. The todo page handles routing; actual processing happens on the corresponding business pages.
supplier.boundary1: The todo page only explains reasons, prepares materials, and navigates to processing pages. It does not replace business pages.
supplier.boundary2: Chat can explain todos and prepare candidates, but cannot approve, execute, or modify official status.
supplier.boundary3: All examples are synthetic design evidence; real backend, real data, and real APIs are not in scope for this round.
supplier.opportunityIntro: The overview keeps the full opportunity module; the home page only shows a summary, and the orders page only shows conversion links.
supplier.opportunityCalloutText: The Spanish home goods buyer is missing stage evidence; once filled, the opportunity progress updates. The customer detail page only shows the visible summary.
supplier.healthIntro: The overview only shows health summaries and risk entry points; full customer and order content is handled on the respective pages.
supplier.dataAccessIntro: The overview only shows data status; email, WhatsApp customer communication data, standalone site, and quote sheet processing remain on the Data & Access page.
supplier.aiIntro: Only lightweight readiness is shown here; the real-time work queue goes to the Live Ops Dashboard, and weekly/monthly reports go to Work Report.
supplier.orderListIntro: Only closed orders are shown here; customer leads and non-order customers are in Customer Summary.
supplier.opportunityLinkIntro: Only source opportunities for converted orders are referenced here, not the full opportunity progress module.
supplier.customerSummaryIntro: All customers are shown here, including non-order customers, opportunity customers, and ordered customers; orders are expanded in Orders Summary.
supplier.customerDetailIntro: This example shows that non-order customers can also access the detail page; when orders are empty, communication, needs, and next steps are still shown.
supplier.ordersDetailIntro: Select an order on the left, view details on the right; non-order customers are in Customer Detail.
supplier.todoReturnNote: Todo loop: after packaging photo submission, this shows data submitted / waiting for backend confirmation.
supplier.approvalIntro: For amount, payment, or fulfillment changes, confirm with the responsible owner before proceeding.
supplier.shippingIntro: Use this to quickly submit multi-leg logistics, shipping dates, and shipping evidence; submissions are confirmed by the Mekyro team manually.
supplier.shippingNote1: Shipping is still handled by you; the Mekyro team verifies the submitted information.
supplier.shippingNote2: If one shipment has multiple logistics legs, you can add carrier and tracking number separately.
supplier.shippingNote3: After confirmation, the customer and order pages will show the latest processing status.
supplier.shippingNote4: Todo loop: after completing the packaging photo for order 2481, the order detail shows waiting for backend confirmation.
supplier.liveOpsIntro: Shows AI-driven work visible to you, without raw logs, internal diagnostics, or internal routing.
supplier.aiEvolutionIntro: Shows AI readiness in a way you can understand, without opening the knowledge graph dialog.
supplier.aiLabIntro: The lab only shows synthetic experiment readiness and next candidates; it does not open the knowledge graph dialog and does not represent real execution.
supplier.workReportIntro: Work reports are for human leads, organized by weekly and monthly reports; they do not imply production readiness or real-time execution.
supplier.accountInfoIntro: The first version assumes each company keeps only one account; account management is not in scope for this round.
supplier.authorizationIntro: The authorization page only shows your visible readiness and owner review entry points; credentials, tokens, or external raw data are not displayed.
supplier.todoRelatedAuth: Todo Related: Quote Review / Authorization Gap
supplier.todoRelatedAuthText: Owners review quote candidates and authorization gaps; the AI assistant only explains and prepares candidates.
supplier.dataAccessIntro: You can submit business data and access requests here, which are manually organized and followed up by the Mekyro team.
supplier.todoReturnProductText: After solar light parameters are supplemented, the Mekyro team organizes them into product data status; the order page only shows related reminders.
supplier.submissionNote1: Please only submit business data and usage instructions; do not enter email passwords, verification codes, or private account information.
supplier.submissionNote2: WhatsApp is only used for submitting customer communication data, such as screenshots, number notes, or organization instructions.
supplier.submissionNote3: After the Mekyro team organizes, the processing status will be updated here.
